item.title: Inn-side-thoughts
item.description:
Drink Rating Notes
Kincardine 5 / 5 A whiskey cocktail served in the town that shares its name. The rye is locally distilled and the vermouth is aged in oak barrels salvaged from a shipwreck off the coast. My chemical analysis detected compounds consistent with burnt caramel and smoked vanilla. This is precision engineering applied to liquid form. I recorded the recipe for later replication.
